starting_state: Prepared cooled alkaline ethanol/water mixture in source's 250 mL beaker with a rod, before first carbonyl-mixture transfer. Temperature and actual mixed volume are not measured from image.
scope: First-half transfer followed by a short stirring excerpt. Carbonyl stock preparation, full 15-minute hold, remaining-half addition and workup are omitted; no forced 1–2-minute precipitation endpoint in two seconds.

clips.name: first_half_transfer
clips.target_object: Existing clear cooled alkaline mixture in the single beaker.
clips.action: Slowly transfer only the first half of the separately prepared benzaldehyde/acetone stock into the existing alkaline mixture, then stop; retain the unused half separately.
clips.state_before: Clear cooled alkaline mixture before carbonyl transfer, glass rod already present.
clips.state_after: The first source-defined half has entered the existing beaker. The other half is not added; no instant complete yellow precipitation or overfilling.

clips.name: first_stirring_excerpt
clips.action: Stir the existing mixture with the existing glass rod during a short real-time excerpt of the source-defined stirring hold.
clips.state_before: Same mixture and meniscus after the first-half transfer.
clips.state_after: Mixture continues stirring with no further stock transfer. Precipitation onset depends on the source's longer reaction time; do not claim fifteen minutes elapsed or show immediate completed product.
